content_of_post_to_answer: How do you study while ignoring your life problems?
answer: Trying to study by ignoring life problems often fails because the mind does not work like a computer with unwanted tabs closed. The goal is not to pretend problems do not exist, but to give them a defined place so they stop consuming every moment. A short period to acknowledge what hurts can create more focus than hours spent fighting your own thoughts. Studying becomes easier when you stop treating your struggles as an enemy and start managing their space.
